name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: Microsoft restored 365 services on 14 Nov after an outage from 12 Nov hit Exchange email, Teams and Intune worldwide
state: Microsoft 365 problems began with Exchange Online on 12 Nov and spread to Teams, SharePoint, Copilot and Intune; on 13 Nov services were still degraded with no full-recovery time given (Computerworld, 13 Nov). Microsoft said on 14 Nov that service had been restored for the remaining customers, blaming an earlier network capacity upgrade and finding no malicious activity (Digital Trends, 14 Nov). The outage ran inside the past 48 hours, so Watch stays; no other major outage was found.
for_you: Organisations that rely on Microsoft 365 for email and device management were most affected. After long outages, delayed mail and sync backlogs can take time to clear. Microsoft's service health dashboard is the official source on remaining issues.
rubric_hit: Major cloud outage > 2h in past 48h: Microsoft 365 degraded from 12 Nov until restoration on 14 Nov

sources.title: Computerworld — Microsoft 365 services slowly come back online after global outage

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
